author: KEXP
description: Jakarta-based instrumental group Basajan blend Sudanese traditions with modern psychedelic rock to create their self-described "Priangan Psychedelic Groove." Live from Bali, the band share a performance of "Budak Leutik Bisa Ngapung" and more.
title: Basajan performs "Budak Leutik Bisa Ngapung" & more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with Basajan performing at Locca Sea House. Recorded August 28, 2026

Songs:
Pileuleuyan 00:48
Uleman 01:53
Budak Leutik Bisa Ngapung 04:22
Panonpoé 08:17
Nadoman 12:57
Waas 17:08

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN. Recorded at Locca Sea House, in Bali, Indonesia
